_comment: Quartermasters (hub vendors, Phase 11). They sell the `sell` list for coins and buy any material back at its price x buyBack (materials on neither list fetch `junk` coins each). Red Fang Triad members also see the black market (`blackMarket`) and can buy a bounty pardon for pardonPerInfamy coins per point of infamy. Talk to a Quartermaster of your own side.
_travel: Fast travel from a Quartermaster to any hub of your side, your camp or your crew hall: base + perKm x distance coins (Free Isles League pays less, see factions.json). Not within combatSeconds of a fight, and not with a bounty above maxInfamy.
